description: No clean concept found. Fires mostly on sparse, early-to-middle boards where columns 0-1 on the left are still empty (especially column 1), the opponent has low stones in the centre or right (bottom of column 3, columns 5-6, sometimes stacked), and my own stones are not in the low centre. It is strongly left/right asymmetric (mirrored positions do not fire), and it is low when stones sit in column 1 or when I stack on the centre.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to max or zero changes move probabilities by at most about 0.09 (zeroing it in one position moved about 8 points from column 0 to column 3).
notes: Tried: col-1-empty + opponent bottom-centre stones (F1 0.18), sparse-board/undeveloped-left rule (F1 0.205, best), first-player+col1 empty (0.19), opponent vertical runs on top of columns (0.15), hand-weighted cell score (0.18; AUROC <=0.70). Simulation share 0.08 for all. Minimal pairs give inconsistent results that depend on context (e.g. 1743 game 8.2, mirrored 0.07; adding any stone pair usually lowers it). Probably a mixture or a random direction. Synthesis 8.944 beats dev max 8.687. Call 2 was an accidental duplicate of call 1.
